candidates.snippet: With Hurricane Isaias' landfall close, a rare extreme wind warning has been issued for more than 500,000 people in the western Florida Panhandle by The National Weather Service. Follow live updates. https://t.co/KaWuYFQTpX

Conditions are deteriorating quickly along the Gulf Coast with Hurricane Isaias only hours from making landfall. Thousands of residents are without power and the storm surge is already being felt.

Follow live updates: https://t.co/rpJpy9IJ95 https://t.co/dE1bTm5sIu
